name: DX Toolkit
description: Developer utilities for Drupal developers: plugin systems, enhanced core utilities, and service helpers.
project_description: DX Toolkit is a code-only developer library for building Drupal custom and contrib modules. It ships no routes, permissions, blocks, or configuration UI; instead it provides reusable PHP primitives that reduce boilerplate. Its EntityGenerator plugin system (annotation @EntityGenerator, manager plugin.manager.entity_generator, base EntityGeneratorBase, and the EntityTypeSourceEntityDeriver) programmatically creates companion configuration entities across the bundles of a source entity type, with a FeedTypeGeneratorBase specialization for the Feeds ecosystem. It defines a @ServiceInjector annotation describing a factory-based auto-service pattern (the demo submodule contains example plugins for it). It also adds a ServiceInstance pattern (ServiceInstanceInterface / ServiceInstanceTrait for MyService::getService() static access), extended plugin base classes and managers (PluginManager with createInstances/getPluginDerivatives/optionLabels, plus a PluginManagerPropertyQueryTrait findByProperties helper), an OO wrapper over core State (StateBase), and hardened extensions of core component utilities: Color (hex normalization, luminance, YIQ / 50% / luminance contrast selection), Json (control-character and BOM stripping), Environment (CLI detection), ArrayUtilities, OptionsGenerator, EntityFieldPropertyAdapter, and the Extension helper. The bundled dx_toolkit_demo submodule demonstrates the ServiceInjector pattern. This is a beta release intended for community testing.
